title: Analyzer / LIS Worklist
description: Raw analyzer messages, matched results and quarantined messages awaiting reconciliation.

importError.unmappedTestCode: Machine test code is not mapped
importError.sampleRejected: Sample is rejected or awaiting recollection
importError.parameterNotFound: Parameter does not exist on the result template

hints.matchingKey: Messages are matched only by sample barcode or accession number. Patient names are never used as a matching key.
hints.idempotency: A repeated message control id is recorded as a duplicate and never creates a second result value.
hints.reconcile: Correct the sample identifier or machine test code, then replay the archived payload. The original message is preserved.
hints.overrideImport: Replacing an analyzer-transmitted value requires the override permission and a recorded reason.

messages.imported: Message imported and attached to the result.
messages.quarantined: Message quarantined. It was not attached to any patient record.
messages.duplicate: Message was already received and has been recorded as a duplicate.
messages.reconciled: Message reconciled and attached to the result.
messages.queueEmpty: No analyzer messages have been received for this branch.

errors.generic: The analyzer message could not be processed.
errors.LAB_LIS_MESSAGE_INVALID: Message payload could not be read.
errors.LAB_LIS_MESSAGE_CONTROL_ID_REQUIRED: Message control id is missing from the payload.
errors.LAB_LIS_SAMPLE_ID_REQUIRED: Machine sample id is missing from the payload.
errors.LAB_LIS_DUPLICATE_MESSAGE: This message control id was already received.
errors.LAB_LIS_BRANCH_ACCESS_DENIED: You cannot process messages for another branch.
errors.LAB_LIS_ALREADY_PROCESSED: Message was already processed and cannot be replayed.
errors.LAB_LIS_NOT_QUARANTINED: Only quarantined or pending messages can be reconciled.
errors.LAB_LIS_MAPPING_EXISTS: This machine test code is already mapped.
errors.LAB_LIS_MAPPING_SERVICE_INVALID: Selected catalog service is not valid for this tenant.
errors.LAB_LIS_ANALYZER_INVALID: Selected analyzer is not valid for this tenant.
errors.LAB_LIS_OVERRIDE_NOT_PERMITTED: You are not permitted to overwrite an analyzer-imported result.
errors.LAB_LIS_OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required to overwrite an analyzer-imported result.
errors.UNMAPPED_TEST_CODE: Machine test code is not mapped for this analyzer.
errors.UNKNOWN_SAMPLE_BARCODE: No sample matches the transmitted barcode.
errors.SAMPLE_REJECTED: Sample is rejected or awaiting recollection.
errors.PARAMETER_NOT_FOUND: Parameter does not exist on the result template.
